title: The task-list surface renders every step with one of the four GOV.UK completion states and an ARIA progressbar naming the completion count
asA: operator working through a multi-step form
iWant: a task-list surface that shows me every step in order, tells me for each step whether I Cannot start yet, have Not started, am In progress or have Completed it, and announces the total number completed
soThat: I can see at a glance where I am, decide which step to pick up next, and know when I have nothing left to do before the summary review

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the wizard task-list route, the rendered surface exposes [data-surface="task-list"] carrying a [role="progressbar"] with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemax and aria-valuetext, and one child element per step carrying [data-step-slug] and [data-step-state] whose value is one of the closed set {Cannot start yet, Not started, In progress, Completed}. The pack drives the real browser to /task-list and reads the state string per step, the progressbar values, and the enumerated step order.
